name: Chthonic-Catafalque
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past an orbital debris ring, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
